Install a plugin from a custom registry with checksum verification

```text
finfocus plugin registry install <registry> <plugin> [flags]
```

## Options

```text
      --confirm-registry string   Type the registry name to authorize its first install
  -h, --help[=true|false]         help for install
      --version string            Release version (default: latest)
```

```text
      --cache-ttl int                     cache TTL in seconds; when set, overrides FINFOCUS_CACHE_TTL and config (0 disables the cache)
      --debug[=true|false]                enable debug logging
      --dry-run[=true|false]              emit the envelope without side effects
      --format string                     output format: json or human
      --idempotency-key string            opaque key used to prevent duplicate-create retries
      --project-dir string                explicit Pulumi project directory for config resolution
      --skip-version-check[=true|false]   skip plugin spec version compatibility check
```
